description: This file defines the LayerGroup class which manages a collection of map layers in the Leaflet library. It provides methods to add, remove, query, and iterate over layers as a single group, facilitating batch operations on multiple layers.

classes.name: LayerGroup
classes.description: A class extending Layer that manages a group of layers, allowing bulk addition, removal, and iteration over the contained layers.

methods.name: addLayer
methods.description: Adds a specified layer to the group and onto the map if the group is added.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a specified layer from the group and from the map if applicable.

methods.name: hasLayer
methods.description: Checks if a specified layer or layer ID is part of the group.

methods.name: clearLayers
methods.description: Removes all layers from the group.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls a specified method on all layers in the group, passing additional arguments.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds all layers in the group to the map.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes all layers in the group from the map.

methods.name: eachLayer
methods.description: Iterates over all layers in the group, applying a specified function.

methods.name: getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves a layer by its internal ID.

methods.name: getLayers
methods.description: Returns an array of all layers in the group.

methods.name: setZIndex
methods.description: Sets the z-index for all layers in the group.

methods.name: getLayerId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID for a given layer.
